system.description:
Play the Radical if you want to uncover truth and confront deception with ruthless clarity.

Features

Interrogating Gaze. Once per Rest, when you engage directly with someone, you may spend up to 3 Hope to ask the GM one question about them per Hope spent:

  • What do they fear?
  • What do they desire?
  • What are they hiding?

Wrathful Candor. When you speak your interpretation of the truth after using Interrogating Gaze, spend a Hope to force each adversary within Far range to make a Reaction Roll (15). On a failure, they become temporarily Vulnerable.
